result.title: probe: matrix empty axes and include key display (throwaway, do not merge)
result.body:
Scratch probe for three unverified matrix beliefs. Never merged; closed unmerged once the head dispatch concludes.

- M1: empty literal axis `a: []` beside a plain sibling — does the file start at all?
- M2: empty dynamic axis from a job output beside a plain sibling.
- M3: `exclude` wiping every combination, beside a plain sibling.
- M4: include re-adding an excluded combination, and an overwriting include, both without a `name:` so the generated parenthetical is visible.
- M5: `name: build \${{ matrix.label }}` over a matrix where only one row carries `label`.
- M6: job-level `if:` reading `matrix.label`.

commit.message:
Drop the coverage requirement (#370)

* Drop the coverage requirement

willfire enforces no coverage floor at any level. The conventions call
allowlists every gate but `unit-coverage`, which carries both the whole-tree
and the changed-lines coverage jobs.

The unit suite stays. AGENTS.md now records why it is not evidence: a unit test
asserts what its author believed, so only the integration and e2e fixtures —
recordings of live CI — verify the check-name contract.

release: skip

* Arm every PR, and name what counts as evidence about GitHub (#377)

release: skip

result:
name: putitoutthere check

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'putitoutthere.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'scripts/*/package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/release.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/check.yml'

jobs:
  putitoutthere-check:
    uses: thekevinscott/putitoutthere/.github/workflows/check.yml@v0

name: Testing Conventions (willfire)

# Runs the upstream testing-conventions gates over the root `willfire` package,
# pinned to the rolling `v0` tag (the same convention as check.yml).
#
# Every gate runs (`gates` left at its empty default): mutation's Stryker deps
# are in devDependencies, and `e2e-attestations/` holds the receipt the
# e2e-verify gate checks.
#
# One workflow file per workspace package (docs/monorepo.md), because `paths:`
# is per-file and each package's lane has a different trigger set.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - '.github/workflows/conventions-src.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - '.github/workflows/conventions-src.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Job id kept as-is: it prefixes every check name this call produces.
  conventions:
    uses: thekevinscott/testing-conventions/.github/workflows/testing-conventions.yml@v0
    with:
      languages: '["typescript"]'
      source: src

name: integration

# The suite builds `src` and replays `tests/integration`, importing
# `tests/cases.ts` and `tests/getResponse.ts`; `attestations.test.ts` reads
# `e2e-attestations/`. `tests/e2e` and `tests/fixtures` are read by no CI job.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/integration/**'
      - 'tests/cases.ts'
      - 'tests/getResponse.ts'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/integration.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  integration:
    name: integration
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test:integration

name: lint

on:
  pull_request:
    # eslint.config.js only matches src/**/*.ts and scripts/*/src/**/*.ts.
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'scripts/*/src/**'
      - 'eslint.config.js'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/lint.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm lint

name: PR Monitor

on:
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  monitor:
    name: 'CI Gate'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The action has no timeout of its own (see monitor.ts) — this is the
    # backstop. If a predicted run never dispatches, the gate waits here
    # until the job is killed.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: thekevinscott/pr-monitor@v1

name: probe M1 empty literal axis
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  m1-sibling:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: 'true'
  m1-empty-literal:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        a: []
    steps:
      - run: 'true'

name: probe M3 full exclude wipe
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  m3-sibling:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

name: Release

# putitoutthere's reusable workflow; config lives in `putitoutthere.toml`
# at the repo root.
#
# Auth: the `NPM_TOKEN` secret is the first-publish bootstrap only —
# Trusted Publishing on npm binds to an already-published package, so
# the very first publish has no OIDC path. `willfire` is published:
# register the trusted publisher (repo thekevinscott/willfire,
# workflow release.yml, environment release), then DELETE the NPM_TOKEN
# secret; the OIDC exchange takes over.
#
# Filename matters: npm's trust policy matches the caller workflow
# filename. Renaming this file requires re-registering the trusted
# publisher.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_packages:
        description: >
          Packages to release manually, bypassing change detection.
          Comma-separated list of name[@<bump|version>] entries, e.g.
          "willfire@minor" or "willfire@1.2.0". Leave empty to fall back
          to automatic change detection (same as a push).
        required: false
        default: ''

jobs:
  release:
    uses: thekevinscott/putitoutthere/.github/workflows/release.yml@v0
    with:
      release_packages: ${{ inputs.release_packages || '' }}
    secrets:
      NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      # Required even for the token-auth bootstrap publish: the
      # reusable workflow's publish job declares id-token: write, and
      # a caller granting less is a startup error.
      id-token: write

  # PyPI upload runs in the caller's workflow context (see
  # pypi/warehouse#11096). The `if:` gate skips this job for non-PyPI
  # repos — pasted verbatim per putitoutthere's README regardless of
  # what the repo publishes.
  pypi-publish:
    needs: release
    if: needs.release.outputs.has_pypi == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: '*-sdist'
          path: dist/
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: '*-wheel-*'
          path: dist/
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1

name: typecheck

# `tsc -p tsconfig.json`, whose include is `src` alone.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/typecheck.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  typecheck:
    name: typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm typecheck

name: unit

# Colocated tests over `src` alone. Only this job carries the coverage floor:
# `src/` reaches 100% from its colocated tests, so the integration suite is
# not propping the number up.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/unit.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  unit:
    name: unit (100% coverage)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test:unit
